s01.text: Here is one article, end to end. From an idea the engine found, to a live page on your website, with a person at every gate.

s02.text: It starts on the Ideas board. The engine discovers article ideas grounded in your company profile, your Topics and your keyword strategy, and lands them in the Discovered column. You approve the ones worth writing and reject the rest. Only approved ideas are drafted.

s03.text: Every thirty minutes the sweep picks up approved ideas, inside the weekly target you set. It writes the article from your brand context, tone and expert profiles, then moves it across the board: drafting, in review, final approval, published.

s04.text: Open it and everything is already there. A focus keyword, meta title, meta description and slug. A featured image and a branded social preview, generated from your brand kit, or uploaded. Metadata you write by hand is never overwritten.

s05.text: The checklist shows every gate and whether it passes. Metadata, slug, focus keyword, alt text on every image, no unsourced claims, every citation verified, a branded preview image. Auto-review fixes what it can. Whatever it cannot fix parks in your Inbox, with the action on the card.

s06.text: At final approval it waits for your publish day, in your timezone. Or set a date for this one article. Or publish it right now. WordPress connected directly. No WordPress? Download a self-contained H T M L file, add it to any site, and mark the article as published with the live link.

s07.text: From an approved idea to a live article, with every gate visible and a person deciding at each one. Me You Social Publisher.
